links.outcome: AF sensitivity/specificity under naive, pragmatic, and intention-to-diagnose reporting frameworks
links.effect: Apple Watch naive 96.1%/97.9%, pragmatic 78.1%/81.0%, ITD 92.2%/91.0%; naive reporting excluding inconclusive results inflates performance, pragmatic deflates it.
links.quote: Apple Watch naive sensitivity/specificity were 96.1%/97.9%; pragmatic 78.1%/81.0%; ITD 92.2%/91.0%.

links.outcome: Repeatability of ECG algorithm output across repeated recordings
links.effect: Kappa 0.77 (substantial) for Apple Watch native algorithm vs 0.96 (near-perfect) for AI algorithm.
links.quote: Repeatability was substantial for Apple Watch (kappa 0.77) and near-perfect for AI (0.96).

links.outcome: AI algorithm vs existing Apple Watch algorithm on identical recordings
links.effect: AI pragmatic 98.4%/96.1% and ITD 98.4%/96.6%, with 92% reduction in inconclusive outputs vs Apple Watch.
links.quote: The AI algorithm achieved pragmatic 98.4%/96.1% and ITD 98.4%/96.6%, with 92% reduction in inconclusive outputs vs Apple Watch.
